subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical Windows Scheduled Task restart/health tracker until live proof covers the remaining direct /Run, foreground-listener, and post-ready health paths?
rationale: Current main fixes several subsets, but the remaining work spans overlapping open issues and an open proof-blocked PR, so automation should not choose the ownership split or close target without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Broad Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while narrower PRs/issues resolve the remaining Windows Scheduled Task paths and require live Windows proof before closing it.

options.title: Close To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this issue only after copying any unique post-ready health context to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90158 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91144 or another focused issue.

options.title: Split Post-Ready Health
options.body: Open or designate a separate focused issue for post-ready HTTP/port loss, then close this broad issue as superseded by the split trackers.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while narrower PRs/issues resolve the remaining Windows Scheduled Task paths and require live Windows proof before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and already carried the related policy-close restart-health fix.
